$Comment: The off-ladder BOSS tier. Roll.Weight 0 keeps it out of the normal weighted roll; it is granted exclusively through Families.ForceGroups, which claims every role in the Mmoscaling_Bosses NPCGroup tagset. Add roles to that tagset (or role-name globs to Families.ForceRoles here) to hand them this tier. Force bypasses the weight, the difficulty band, the rarity spawn chance, and the allow/deny gate, but it is a FLOOR: a normal roll that lands on a stronger tier still wins. A per-world Pool.Rarities deny for 'boss' still suppresses it in that world.
